name: Add Account Custom Nameserver
description: Add Account Custom Nameserver Adds a custom nameserver to the account for use as a vanity nameserver on zones. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/custom_ns
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/custom_ns
Adds a custom nameserver to the account for use as a vanity nameserver on zones.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Account Custom Nameserver
description: Delete Account Custom Nameserver Removes a custom nameserver from the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/custom_ns/{custom_ns_id}

name: List Account Custom Nameservers
description: List Account Custom Nameservers List an account's custom nameservers. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/custom_ns
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/custom_ns
List an account's custom nameservers.
Required: account_id (path)
